# bitaxeorg/ESP-Miner issue #1130: Convert logos to 1 bit images

> Source: https://github.com/bitaxeorg/ESP-Miner/issues/1130
> Collected: 2026-10-07

- Repository: bitaxeorg/ESP-Miner

- State: open
- Author: mutatrum
- Opened: 2025-07-05
- Closed: n/a
- Labels: cleanup

## Description

The logo's are 1-bit images, but stored as RGB565. These can be 8x smaller by defining them as 1-bit image.

Unfortunately, that doesn't work yet. This is a tracker issue for https://github.com/lvgl/lvgl/issues/8540.

### mutatrum on 2025-08-14

It only works if `LV_DRAW_SW_SUPPORT_ARGB8888` is enabled, as palette bitmaps needs to be converted to RGB888 format before they can be drawn. Unfortunately, this nixes the data savings:
```
┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┳━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┳━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓
┃ Memory Type/Section ┃ Used [before] ┃ Used [after] ┃
┡━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━╇━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━╇━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┩
│ Flash Code          │        903032 │       916972 │
│ Flash Data          │        205992 │       195800 │
└─────────────────────┴───────────────┴──────────────┘
```
So 14kb code is added to save 10kb in the two logo bitmaps.

### mutatrum on 2025-11-20

With #1323 we enabled `LV_DRAW_SW_SUPPORT_ARGB8888`, so the extra code size is nullified now. With the new bitmap on #1369 it also makes more sense.
